title: An Open CoT-Monitor Harness: How Reliably Can a Cheap LLM Judge Flag Unfaithfulness?

original_idea.body: CoT-monitor harness measuring monitor precision/recall/ROC on cue-flip labeled traces.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: CoT monitoring is a recognized safety strategy and quantifying monitor reliability is a defensible prerequisite to trusting it.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: clear inherited methodology (cue-flip labels, judge model, ROC) executable by novice+mentor with standard tools.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: build labeled set, run monitor, report precision/recall/ROC with well-defined success criteria.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open monitoring infrastructure, public models/data, weak lab incentive to release.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only with small open models; single GPU sufficient.

novelty.reasoning: Monitor-reliability is studied but an open reusable precision/recall harness may be an open angle.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: CoT monitors studied but the open reusable harness angle may be open.
